trim.noCue: {file} has no .cue sheet next to it

detail.noGod: no Games on Demand package was found in this folder (an extension-less file with its .data folder beside it)
detail.severalGames: this folder holds several games: pick one game’s own folder
detail.notOneGame: this folder is not one game: pick the game’s own folder
detail.resultMissing: the converter reported success but its result was not found
detail.ps5HelperMissing: PlayOut’s PS5 package helper is missing (resources\ps5pkg\PlayOutPs5Pkg.exe): reinstall PlayOut
detail.ps5HelperNoStart: the PS5 package helper could not start: {error}
detail.ps5HelperStopped: the PS5 package helper stopped (exit code {code})
detail.xboxHelperMissing: PlayOut’s Xbox helper is missing (resources\xbox\PlayOutXbox.exe): reinstall PlayOut
detail.xboxHelperNoStart: the Xbox helper could not start: {error}
detail.xboxResultMissing: the Xbox helper reported success but its result was not found
detail.unverifiedKept: original kept: the converter does not check this result
detail.partlyKept: original kept: some results were already there
detail.combined: combined with the game it belongs to
detail.renamedKept_one: original kept: {count} name was changed for Windows
detail.renamedKept_other: original kept: {count} names were changed for Windows

chooseFiles: Choose at least one file to convert.
closing: PlayOut is closing: no conversion starts now.

tool.noWindows: the converter's latest release has no Windows download

needs.switchKeys: Switch packages that carry a ticket need your prod.keys (packages without one convert without it).
needs.wiiKey: This Wii conversion needs your Wii common key, or Dolphin installed (Settings › Emulators), whose DolphinTool does it.
needs.ps3Unpack: Unpacking PS3 packages needs RPCS3 installed (Settings › Emulators), or your own package key.
needs.ps3PackKey: Making a PS3 package needs your own package key.

pkg.notPs4: this is not a PS4 package (a PS3 or Vita package cannot be unpacked here)
pkg.endsEarly: the package ends early: it is incomplete or damaged
pkg.fsOutsideImage: the package’s file system points outside its image: it is damaged
pkg.fsUnreadable: the package’s file system is not readable: the package is damaged
pkg.fsMissingFile: the package’s file system names a file it does not have: it is damaged
pkg.blockTooLarge: a block of the package’s game data is damaged (too large)
pkg.blockDecompress: a block of the package’s game data could not be decompressed: it is damaged
pkg.blockDecompressLarge: a block of the package’s game data is damaged (decompresses too large)
pkg.badName: the package holds a file with an unusable name ({name})
pkg.unsafePath: the package holds an unsafe path
pkg.noKeys: the package has no keys: it is damaged
pkg.retail: this is a retail package, locked with Sony’s keys: only fake packages (fPKG) can be unpacked
pkg.folderAppeared: a folder named {folder} appeared while unpacking
pkg.incomplete: the package is incomplete (smaller than its header says)
pkg.noImage: the package has no game data image
pkg.noImageFile: the package has no game data image (pfs_image.dat)
pkg.imageDamaged: the package’s game data image is damaged
pkg.fsOutsideData: the package’s file system points outside its data: it is damaged
pkg.blockSizes: the package’s game data image is damaged (block sizes differ)
pkg.noUroot: the package’s game files were not found (no uroot)
pkg.fileShort: a file in the package is shorter than its size: the package is damaged

xboxTimeout: the Xbox helper did not answer in time
